scope: Static design mockup only; no game code changes
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined celadon-theme Chinese mobile game UI design presentation, updating reference image 1. ONE landscape image with TWO large complete portrait app screens side by side, same size, aligned at top, no phone hardware. Left gameplay, right food collection. Preserve image 1's brand plaque, Chinese art, bamboo courtyard, ivory/jade/antique gold porcelain materials, crisp hand-painted delicious food assets, elegant clarity. Reference image 2 is ONLY a structural reference for the existing game prop row: keep its three existing tools, not its red theme.
PRIMARY CHANGES: NO BOTTOM TABS anywhere; demonstrate luminous special-food backgrounds and unobtrusive relocated entry buttons. Brand exact text “锅里捞啥” centered with IDENTICAL plaque width (68% screen width), height and y-position in both screens; completely independent of other controls. Absolutely no giant book, no gear alongside brand. Beneath brand put ONE compact horizontal information/action row: gameplay left a SMALL book icon + “图鉴”, centered “第3关·千层盛宴”, right a SMALL gear icon + “设置”. Collection corresponding row: small “返回” left, “食材图鉴” centered, small gear + “设置” right. These controls fit naturally without crowding or shifting centered text. Use clear understated buttons and adequate touch space.
LEFT gameplay: smaller counter beneath toolbar, “剩余 36 / 72”. Large cream porcelain game board with jade and thin gold frame. About 25 overlapping layered square food tiles in a playable uneven cluster. Ordinary food tofu, beef rolls, mushrooms, bamboo shoot on normal ivory-green tiles. Two special foods 松茸 and 羊肚菌 are clearly more precious: fine champagne-gold double rim, tiny corner “珍” seal, softly glowing pearl-gold base, luminous rim, a delicately curling jade-gold aura around the tile. Light must be clearly perceptible but restrained, no neon or distracting giant flares. Food is sharp, well lit and appetizing; shadows distinguish covered tiles, and covered tiles stay dim. Bottom of gameplay retains seven-slot holding tray, then an existing three-tool row: “撤回” with curved-back-arrow icon, “炸” with bomb icon, “翻锅” with shuffle icon; each tool a jade rounded button with small count badge “1”. Bottommost two smaller buttons “重新开始” and “声音：开”. Fit whole screen comfortably, no navigation strip, no UI cutoff.
RIGHT collection: beneath unified header/action row, two compact tabs “普通食材” and selected “珍藏食材”, counter “已发现 6 / 10”. Six generously sized portrait cards, 3 columns × 2 rows. Exact food names in order “松茸”, “羊肚菌”, “黑松露”, “花胶”, “海参”, “鱼子酱”. Avoid crab, lobster and shells. Refined painted hot-pot food on celadon dishes. PREMIUM GLOW IS THE FOCAL POINT: each card's background is softly luminous translucent jade with warm gold pearlescence, wispy flowing satin light that curves behind the food, a soft diagonal champagne light sweep, fine gold borders, delicate sparkling light points, small “珍藏” seal. Show the captured moment of a gentle moving shimmer; different cards have slightly offset light-sweep phases to imply asynchronous slow breathing, never flash or glitter overload. Keep all food labels on quiet cream bands, dark jade legible text. Food remains visually foremost. Below grid a graceful short copy “每次相遇，都有新的惊喜。” and a large simple bottom “返回游戏” button, NO bottom tabs.
Neutral cream presentation background with bamboo corners and small heading “青瓷雅韵 · 珍藏流光效果”. Under the two screens, a tiny non-UI design caption “柔光呼吸 · 流光轻扫 · 金边微亮” to describe the animation concept. Do not add other text, secret food appearance rules, probabilities, instructions, English or watermark. This is a beautiful actual game interface design, not photorealistic framed phones or an infographic. Glows are warm and elegant, not neon fantasy. Keep exact title and all key labels correct.
